record.reason: The primary title is ST-MoE: Designing Stable and Transferable Sparse Expert Models. Its abstract and main sections focus on training instabilities, transfer/fine-tuning quality and scaling a 269B sparse model; the paper reports a 4x pretraining speedup as context but does not study inference-serving efficiency. Its central contribution is sparse-model training stability and transfer, so it is outside the inference-efficiency scope.
